description: A command-line interface for installing and updating different dotnet SDKs
notes: dnvm keeps its SDKs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\dnvm (override with the DNVM_HOME environment variable).
Get started with: dnvm track lts   (or: dnvm track latest)
To use the managed SDK, add %LOCALAPPDATA%\dnvm\dn to your PATH and set DOTNET_ROOT to the same directory.
On Windows the machine PATH wins over the user PATH, so an existing C:\Program Files\dotnet takes precedence over the dnvm-managed dotnet.
Do not run dnvm selfinstall - it installs a second copy of dnvm outside Scoop.
